descriptors.name: Read native tick factor
descriptors.summary: Returns the float at RVA 0x717480 as @FLT. No operands.

descriptors.name: Add vectors
descriptors.summary: Adds all four components of operand 0 and operand 1. Returns @ADR to shared result storage at RVA 0x2AEA798.
descriptors.notes: The adapter replaces NaN components in the referenced input vector(s) with zero before calculating the result. This writes to the input memory. A later invocation overwrites the result. Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required.

descriptors.name: Subtract vectors
descriptors.summary: Subtracts operand 1 from operand 0, across all four components. Returns @ADR to shared result storage at RVA 0x2AEA7B0.
descriptors.notes: The adapter replaces NaN components in the referenced input vector(s) with zero before calculating the result. This writes to the input memory. A later invocation overwrites the result. Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required.

descriptors.name: Vector length
descriptors.summary: Returns sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z) as @FLT; w is ignored.
descriptors.notes: Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required. This adapter does not sanitize NaN values.

descriptors.name: Normalize vector and retain length
descriptors.summary: Normalizes the input xyz components when the computed length is nonzero. Stores the original length in w and returns that length as @FLT.
descriptors.notes: Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required. This changes the input vector and does not sanitize NaN values. A zero-length vector keeps xyz unchanged and writes zero to w.

descriptors.name: Random integer
descriptors.summary: Updates the shared DWORD seed at RVA 0x7535C0 by multiplying it by 69069 modulo 2^32. For unsigned n > 0, returns seed / ceil(2^32 / n) as @INT.
descriptors.notes: n = 0 reaches an integer divide fault after updating the seed and the return tag. This describes the native path, not a recommended call.

descriptors.name: Random float scaled
descriptors.summary: Updates the same shared seed, converts the unsigned 32-bit result to float, multiplies by 2^-32 and by operand 0, and returns @FLT.
descriptors.notes: Float rounding can produce a fraction of 1.0. The decompiler shows a misleading signed cast; the instructions zero-extend through EDX before CVTSI2SS from RDX.

descriptors.name: Random float between
descriptors.summary: Updates the shared seed and calculates a + (b - a) * (float(seed) * 2^-32) using scalar float instructions. Returns @FLT.
descriptors.notes: The seed conversion is unsigned. Float rounding can reach an endpoint; no strictly open upper interval is promised.

descriptors.name: Horizontal angle difference
descriptors.summary: Returns the wrapped difference atan2(b.x, b.z) - atan2(a.x, a.z) as @FLT.
descriptors.notes: Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required. This adapter does not include the vector NaN sanitization loop.

descriptors.name: Integer absolute value
descriptors.summary: Calculates a 32-bit absolute value using CDQ, XOR and SUB, then returns @INT.
descriptors.notes: INT_MIN wraps to the same bit pattern 0x80000000.

descriptors.name: Float absolute value
descriptors.summary: Converts float to double, clears the double sign bit and converts back to float, returning @FLT.
descriptors.notes: NaN payloads and signaling behavior follow those floating-point conversions; this is not a raw float-bit sign mask.

descriptors.name: Write native timing scalar
descriptors.summary: Copies operand 0 as float to RVA 0x717424 through the shared tail at RVA 0x1545B0.
descriptors.notes: The adapter performs no value-range validation. This does not establish all consumers of that global.

descriptors.name: Scale vector in place
descriptors.summary: Multiplies all four components of operand 0 by float operand 1 in place. No VM return slot.
descriptors.notes: Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required. No NaN sanitization loop.

descriptors.name: Scale vector
descriptors.summary: Multiplies all four components of operand 0 by float operand 1. Returns @ADR to shared result storage at RVA 0x2AEA7C8.
descriptors.notes: The adapter replaces NaN components in the referenced input vector(s) with zero before calculating the result. This writes to the input memory. A later invocation overwrites the result. Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required.

descriptors.name: Divide vector
descriptors.summary: Multiplies all four components by the float reciprocal of operand 1. Returns @ADR to shared result storage at RVA 0x2AEA7E0.
descriptors.notes: Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required. No zero-divisor check or NaN sanitization loop. A later invocation overwrites the result.

descriptors.name: Horizontal vector angle
descriptors.summary: Returns atan2(x, z) as @FLT.
descriptors.notes: The adapter replaces NaN components in the referenced input vector(s) with zero before calculating the result. This writes to the input memory. Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required.

descriptors.name: Wrap angle
descriptors.summary: For a finite float, calls the angle wrapper at RVA 0x3B6F20. For a non-finite float, returns zero. Result tag @FLT.
descriptors.notes: The helper uses separate positive and nonpositive branches with fmodf and float approximations of pi and 2*pi.

descriptors.name: Advance along direction
descriptors.summary: Normalizes a copy of operand 1, scales it by float operand 2 and the global tick factor at RVA 0x717480, then adds all four resulting components to operand 0.
descriptors.notes: The adapter replaces NaN components in the referenced input vector(s) with zero before calculating the result. This writes to the input memory. Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required. The copied w component also participates in scale and add.

descriptors.name: Set global bit
descriptors.summary: Sets bit (index & 31) in the DWORD array at RVA 0x9ABCB0, indexed by unsigned index >> 5.
descriptors.notes: No bounds check is present in the adapter or its shared tail.

descriptors.name: Clear global bit
descriptors.summary: Clears bit (index & 31) in the DWORD array at RVA 0x9ABCB0, indexed by unsigned index >> 5.
descriptors.notes: No bounds check is present in the adapter or its shared tail.

descriptors.name: Read global bit
descriptors.summary: Reads bit (index & 31) from the DWORD array at RVA 0x9ABCB0, indexed by unsigned index >> 5. Returns @INT.
descriptors.notes: No bounds check is present in the captured helper.

descriptors.name: No-op adapter
descriptors.summary: The captured native adapter returns immediately without reading its declared operands. The VM still consumes the declared operand count.

descriptors.name: Interpolate vectors
descriptors.summary: Returns a*(1-t) + b*t across all four components, with a=operand 0, b=operand 1 and t=float operand 2. Returns @ADR to RVA 0x7535C8.
descriptors.notes: The adapter replaces NaN components in the referenced input vector(s) with zero before calculating the result. This writes to the input memory. The result buffer is shared with other vector calls, including 0:82, 0:83 and 0:102. Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required.

descriptors.name: Vector cross product
descriptors.summary: Returns the xyz cross product of operand 0 and operand 1 with w=0, as @ADR to shared storage at RVA 0x7535C8.
descriptors.notes: The adapter replaces NaN components in the referenced input vector(s) with zero before calculating the result. This writes to the input memory. This storage is reused by other vector calls. Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required.

descriptors.name: Angle from vector dot product
descriptors.summary: Calculates the xyz dot product without normalizing the vectors, then returns 0 for dot >= 1, pi for dot <= -1, otherwise acos(dot), as @FLT.
descriptors.notes: The adapter replaces NaN components in the referenced input vector(s) with zero before calculating the result. This writes to the input memory. With masked floating-point exceptions, an unordered/NaN dot product reaches acosf; unmasked COMISS can fault before that. Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required.

descriptors.name: Write object field +8
descriptors.summary: Writes the low 32 bits of operand 1 to decoded operand 0 plus 8. No VM return slot.
descriptors.notes: Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required. No object-type or null guard is present in this adapter.

descriptors.name: Dot product of normalized vectors
descriptors.summary: Sanitizes input vectors, normalizes local copies of xyz and returns their xyz dot product as @FLT.
descriptors.notes: The adapter replaces NaN components in the referenced input vector(s) with zero before calculating the result. This writes to the input memory. Normalization acts on copies after sanitization. Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required.

descriptors.name: Add object byte +9

descriptors.notes: Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required. The semantic object type is not established.

descriptors.name: Direction to angles
descriptors.summary: Produces (atan2(-y, sqrt(x*x+z*z)), atan2(x,z), 0, 1). Returns @ADR to shared storage at RVA 0x7535C8.
descriptors.notes: The adapter replaces NaN components in the referenced input vector(s) with zero before calculating the result. This writes to the input memory. Other vector calls overwrite the same storage. Arguments are encoded native pointers; valid allocation and lifetime are required.

descriptors.name: Current Actor pointer
descriptors.summary: Returns the current Actor pointer through RVA 0x3B3E80, encoded as @ADR.
descriptors.notes: No operand. A returned address does not establish a stable Actor lifetime.

descriptors.name: Register movement entry
descriptors.summary: The descriptor declares 12 operands, but adapter RVA 0x42E220 also reads low DWORDs from scratch slots 12, 13, 14 and 15. Callee RVA 0x3CA0E0 uses the values from slots 12 through 14.
descriptors.notes: These reads remain within the native 16-slot scratch buffer. The dispatcher only initializes the 12 declared slots for this call; the additional values are uninitialized scratch contents or values left by an earlier native call. This is not proof of a live crash.

descriptors.name: Actor STATUS rebind
descriptors.summary: Adapter RVA 0x431A70 calls RVA 0x411350. Operand 0 encodes a wrapper whose +4 field encodes an Actor; operand 1 supplies the parameter ID. No return-value slot.
descriptors.notes: The third declared operand is unused by this adapter. The selected retail event-0 paths initialize this wrapper, conditional on successful native setup. General runtime argument validity and object lifetime remain unproved.
